Docs.summary: Well-known connector names for connectors with SDK-generated clients. Use these constants with the [ConnectorTrigger] attribute's ConnectorName property for IntelliSense and compile-time validation.

remarks.para: These constants cover connectors with strongly-typed SDK clients. For connectors without generated clients, use the connector's API name as a plain string.
